notation.decision: Keep every EIA symbol nonnumeric; show its EIA meaning on screen and in Excel, retaining original symbol in Excel. Only numeric zero counts as reported zero. For status/chart a symbol counts as no value: all-symbol places get No data for these years and stay out of chart. Never convert a symbol to zero.
